original_test_intent: Verify front USB3 slot 1 sustains 12 hours of USB stress at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without data, link, controller or platform errors.
original_method: Map the exact connector to its hub/controller and qualified USB3 tool/cable; preserve a timestamped baseline; control chamber humidity/dew point, cold-soak the system, and apply measured +5% rails without overshoot; verify SuperSpeed negotiation and run the approved SST data-integrity profile for 12 hours while recording USB resets/retries/link speed, kernel/BMC events and environmental/electrical data; stop safely, warm above dew point and restore nominal conditions before disconnecting.
manual_activity: Operator installs the USB tool, controls dry cold chamber and high rails, supervises stress and performs safe warm-up.
required_inputs: SuperSpeed link, retry/reset/error and throughput limits
Abort, warm-up, disconnect and restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Prevent condensation during cooling and warm-up
Use calibrated rail measurement and avoid +5% overshoot
Do not clear historical logs; delimit the run
Abort on moisture risk, controller reset storm, data mismatch, rail or thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening or cable work
agent_execution_scope: May analyze supplied link, integrity and event artifacts
Must not manipulate connector, chamber or rails and must not assign verdict
engineer_actions: Supervise the physical run and chamber transitions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; generic USB stress needs explicit SuperSpeed and connector-specific evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator runs the pinned SST USB3 profile after verified SuperSpeed enumeration and stable cold/high-rail conditions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Front USB3 slot1, 0C, +5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate continuous USB3 link/integrity evidence with dew-point, chamber and rail telemetry for the single mapped connector.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds SuperSpeed proof, non-erasing baseline, condensation/overshoot controls, aborts and safe warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: USB2 fallback, another connector or nominal-temperature operation cannot satisfy USB3 slot1 coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A tool may silently re-enumerate at USB2 speed after a cold/high-rail reset, allowing SST activity to continue while losing intended USB3 coverage.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines acceptable link speed, transient retry/reset allowance, integrity volume and environmental stabilization dwell.
expected_evidence: Pre-test USB descriptor and SuperSpeed link
Twelve-hour SST transfer/integrity and link/reset/retry record

review_improvement: Protects cold USB testing from condensation and makes USB3 speed, connector attribution and data integrity explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: SST completion alone may conceal a reset followed by USB2 fallback.
